verdict.rationale: Temporal is a workflow orchestration platform, so a prebuilt connector ecosystem is a fair question for it. The evidence shows no catalog of thousands of vendor-maintained app integrations. The docs describe Temporal as "Workflows-as-Code" and "not a no-code Workflow engine." The only named integrations are AI SDK framework integrations (Google ADK, Vercel AI SDK), which are developer building blocks rather than app connectors.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can connect to thousands of apps through prebuilt, vendor-maintained integrations
